name: model-tint
description: Colour the terminal background by the active Codex model, in macOS Terminal.app and cmux

interface.shortDescription: Colour the terminal by the active model
interface.longDescription: Changes the terminal background colour when the Codex model changes, so you can see which model runs in each tab. Works in macOS Terminal.app and cmux. Colours are configurable in ~/.config/model-tint/colors.
